title: Running footpath
description: The path of each foot through a stride, from a Stryd Duo's Footpath (the Stryd connector: footpath_loop, footpath_segment, footpath_step): a run's typical stride seen from the side, from behind and from above, compared with another run; any stretch of the run, km by km, in 2D and 3D; and the shape of the stride over time at the same pace.

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: IANA time zone the days are cut in (TRIBUTARY_TZ).

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_step" WITH KEY = "user"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_step" WITH KEY = "user"

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.description: The run whose loops are drawn, by its local start time.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_loop" WITH KEY = "run" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_loop" WITH KEY = "run" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: compare
list.label: Compare with
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_loop" WITH KEY = "run" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_loop" WITH KEY = "run" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: from_km
list.label: From km
list.description: Where the stretch drawn km by km starts (km 3 is From 2 To 3).

list.name: to_km
list.label: To km
list.description: Where the stretch ends (the last choice is the run's end).

list.name: foot
list.label: Foot
list.description: The foot drawn along the run in 3D.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_segment" WITH KEY = "side" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_segment" WITH KEY = "side" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: pace
list.label: Pace
list.description: The paces (per km, 15 s bands: 4:30 is 4:30 to 4:44) whose steps the graphs over time read.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_step" WITH KEY = "pace" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "footpath_step" WITH KEY = "pace" WHERE "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Seen from the side
panels.description: The run's typical stride, seen from the side: each foot's path from mid-stance to the next mid-stance, with the run's forward motion taken out, so the loop shows where the foot travels relative to the body. To the right is forward. The foot pushes off and travels back (left of 0), lifts, swings forward, reaches ahead and comes down. It is the median, point by point, of the run's steps at its usual pace (within 5% of its median speed). Dashed: the run to compare with.

targets.query: SELECT "x_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "x_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "x_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$compare' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "x_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$compare' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Seen from behind
panels.description: The same loops seen from behind: sideways and up. Stryd reports the left foot's sideways travel as negative. Dashed: the run to compare with.

targets.query: SELECT "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$compare' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$compare' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Seen from above
panels.description: The same loops seen from above: forward (to the right) and sideways. Dashed: the run to compare with.

targets.query: SELECT "x_cm", "y_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "x_cm", "y_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "x_cm", "y_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$compare' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "x_cm", "y_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$compare' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: The two runs' loops
panels.description: Read on the loops above, per foot: Lift is the loop's highest point; Back swing how far behind the foot travels after push-off, Forward reach how far ahead it swings (both from mid-stance); Sideways its sideways range; Pace and Steps, the pace and the number of steps the loop is the median of.

targets.query: SELECT max("z_cm") AS "Lift", min("x_cm") * -1 AS "Back swing", max("x_cm") AS "Forward reach", spread("y_cm") AS "Sideways", 1000 / last("speed_mps") AS "Pace", last("steps") AS "Steps" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE ("run" = '$run' OR "run" = '$compare') AND "user" = '$user' GROUP BY "run", "side"

panels.title: The run km by km: km $from_km to $to_km
The stretch, from the side
panels.description: The stretch of the run picked in *From km* and *To km* (km 3 is From 2 To 3), per foot: the median, point by point, of the loops of its 500 m segments, each the median of the segment's steps whatever their pace. Dashed: the whole run's typical loop, at its usual pace. To the right is forward.

targets.query: SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user' AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km
SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user' AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km
SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: The stretch, from behind
panels.description: The stretch of the run picked in *From km* and *To km* (km 3 is From 2 To 3), per foot: the median, point by point, of the loops of its 500 m segments, each the median of the segment's steps whatever their pace. Dashed: the whole run's typical loop, at its usual pace.

targets.query: SELECT "phase", "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user' AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km
SELECT "phase", "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user' AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km
SELECT "phase", "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "phase", "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: The stretch, from above
panels.description: The stretch of the run picked in *From km* and *To km* (km 3 is From 2 To 3), per foot: the median, point by point, of the loops of its 500 m segments, each the median of the segment's steps whatever their pace. Dashed: the whole run's typical loop, at its usual pace.

targets.query: SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "y_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user' AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km
SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "y_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user' AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km
SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "y_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "y_cm" FROM "footpath_loop" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: The stretch's form
panels.description: Per foot, over the stretch picked: the median of its 500 m segments' lift, back swing, forward reach, touchdown and sideways travel (each the median of the segment's steps), their pace, the steps they are drawn from, and when the stretch starts, from the run's start.

targets.query: SELECT median("lift_cm") AS "Lift", median("back_cm") AS "Back swing", median("reach_cm") AS "Forward reach", median("touchdown_cm") AS "Touchdown", median("width_cm") AS "Sideways", 1000 / median("speed_mps") AS "Pace", sum("steps") AS "Steps", min("elapsed_s") AS "Starts at" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "phase" = 0 AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km AND "user" = '$user' GROUP BY "side"

panels.title: The stretch in 3D
panels.description: The stretch's loops (as above) in 3D, at the same scale on the three axes: drag to turn it, scroll to zoom. Needs the Business Charts panel plugin (volkovlabs-echarts-panel).

targets.query: SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "user" = '$user' AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km
SELECT "phase", "x_cm", "y_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "user" = '$user' AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km

panels.title: Along the run, in 3D ($foot foot)
panels.description: The loop of each 500 m segment of the stretch, for the foot picked in *Foot*, seen from the side (forward and up) and set along the run's km: light at the stretch's start, dark at its end. A loop that sinks, shortens or reaches further as the km go by shows the stride changing (fatigue, a hill, a rep). Drag to turn it, scroll to zoom. Needs the Business Charts panel plugin (volkovlabs-echarts-panel).

targets.query: SELECT "km", "phase", "x_cm", "z_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = '$foot' AND "user" = '$user' AND "km" >= $from_km AND "km_end" <= $to_km

panels.title: Foot lift along the run
panels.description: How high the foot rises in the swing. One point per 500 m of the run and foot (the median of the segment's steps, whatever their pace), at the km it starts.

targets.query: SELECT "km", "lift_cm" AS "lift_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "km", "lift_cm" AS "lift_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Back swing along the run
panels.description: How far behind the foot travels after push-off. One point per 500 m of the run and foot (the median of the segment's steps, whatever their pace), at the km it starts.

targets.query: SELECT "km", "back_cm" AS "back_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "km", "back_cm" AS "back_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Forward reach along the run
panels.description: How far ahead the foot swings before it comes down. One point per 500 m of the run and foot (the median of the segment's steps, whatever their pace), at the km it starts.

targets.query: SELECT "km", "reach_cm" AS "reach_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "km", "reach_cm" AS "reach_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Touchdown along the run
panels.description: Where the foot meets the ground, ahead of mid-stance (the overstride). One point per 500 m of the run and foot (the median of the segment's steps, whatever their pace), at the km it starts.

targets.query: SELECT "km", "touchdown_cm" AS "touchdown_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "km", "touchdown_cm" AS "touchdown_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Sideways travel along the run
panels.description: The foot's sideways range through the stride. One point per 500 m of the run and foot (the median of the segment's steps, whatever their pace), at the km it starts.

targets.query: SELECT "km", "width_cm" AS "width_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "km", "width_cm" AS "width_cm" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Pace along the run
panels.description: The pace of the segment's steps: the loop grows with speed, so read the figures beside it at the same pace. One point per 500 m of the run and foot (the median of the segment's steps, whatever their pace), at the km it starts.

targets.query: SELECT "km", 1000 / "speed_mps" AS "pace" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'left' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'
SELECT "km", 1000 / "speed_mps" AS "pace" FROM "footpath_segment" WHERE "run" = '$run' AND "side" = 'right' AND "phase" = 0 AND "user" = '$user'

panels.title: Form over time, at the same pace
Foot lift
panels.description: How high the foot rises in the swing (the loop's highest point). One point per run and foot: the median of its steps at the paces picked in *Pace*. Compare runs at the same pace: the loop grows with speed.

targets.query: SELECT median("lift_cm") FROM "footpath_step" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "pace" =~ /^(${pace:regex})$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "side" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Back swing
panels.description: How far behind the foot travels after push-off, from mid-stance. One point per run and foot: the median of its steps at the paces picked in *Pace*. Compare runs at the same pace: the loop grows with speed.

targets.query: SELECT median("back_cm") FROM "footpath_step" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "pace" =~ /^(${pace:regex})$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "side" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Forward reach
panels.description: How far ahead the foot swings before it comes down, from mid-stance. One point per run and foot: the median of its steps at the paces picked in *Pace*. Compare runs at the same pace: the loop grows with speed.

targets.query: SELECT median("reach_cm") FROM "footpath_step" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "pace" =~ /^(${pace:regex})$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "side" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Touchdown
panels.description: Where the foot meets the ground, ahead of mid-stance: the further ahead, the more the foot lands in front of the body (overstriding). One point per run and foot: the median of its steps at the paces picked in *Pace*. Compare runs at the same pace: the loop grows with speed.

targets.query: SELECT median("touchdown_cm") FROM "footpath_step" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "pace" =~ /^(${pace:regex})$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "side" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sideways travel
panels.description: The foot's sideways range through the stride. One point per run and foot: the median of its steps at the paces picked in *Pace*. Compare runs at the same pace: the loop grows with speed.

targets.query: SELECT median("width_cm") FROM "footpath_step" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "pace" =~ /^(${pace:regex})$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "side" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Pace of the steps compared
panels.description: The median pace of the steps the graphs above read, per run: check that the runs compared ran at the same pace. One point per run and foot.

targets.query: SELECT 1000 / median("speed_mps") FROM "footpath_step" WHERE "user" = '$user' AND "pace" =~ /^(${pace:regex})$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "side" fill(none) tz('$tz')
